citations.narrative:
Acquisition records were incomplete. The required acquisition information for the following five dogs was not included in
the Record of Acquisition and Dogs and Cats on hand (APHIS Form 7005): Lucky (female, Dachshund), Ramen (male,
Dachshund), Tofu (male, Dachshund), Bluey (male, French bulldog) and Roma (male, Terrier mix). Complete and
accurate documentation of all acquired dogs and cats is essential for proper identification and in order to facilitate the
tracking of animals. Each dealer and exhibitor shall use Record of Acquisition and Dogs and Cats on Hand (APHIS 7005)
to make, keep and maintain the required information of this section of the Animal Welfare Act. A system of complete and
accurate records must be kept, maintained, and made available for APHIS inspection.

There were no records of acquisition or record of animals on hand for the two pigs available at the time of inspection.
Complete and accurate animal records must be kept current and made available during inspection to facilitate the
identification and tracking of animals as well as ensure their health and well-being. Records must be maintained, which
fully and correctly disclose all the required information concerning all animals purchased or otherwise acquired, owned,
held, leased, transported, sold, euthanized or otherwise disposed of and shall include any offspring born or hatched while
in the licensee’s possession.
Correct by 07/20/2026.
This inspection and exit interview were conducted with a facility representative.
